properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-02 BY WALKING INTO IT, in the same session that shipped the fix for the same class — and the rule's own code comment records its predecessor being caught the same way.

WHAT HAPPENED, in order: an ANTICIPATES edge was drawn from `fact:defect-loop-status-asserts-an-answer-never-reached-the-design-from-a-fact-that-cannot-say-so` to `dec:idea-how-should-the-loop-know-that-an-answer-reached-the-design`. No defect — the target was a `proposed` exploratory idea, and `is_parked_idea` exempts it. Then the decision was SETTLED on the owner's word, `EVOLVES_INTO` was drawn to the ChangeEvent that implements it, and the code shipped with a passing test. Defects went 73 → 74:

  heal:e0abd85e12233d1a (info) — "'fact:defect-loop-status…' anticipates 'dec:idea-how-should-the-loop-know…' but nothing follows through"

⭐ **THE FOLLOW-THROUGH IS THE MOST COMPLETE THIS DESIGN CAN RECORD, AND THAT IS WHAT TRIGGERED THE FINDING.** The decision is `accepted`, carries `EVOLVES_INTO` to a ChangeEvent, and the ChangeEvent's repair is merged code under a test observed to fail first. The finding appeared BECAUSE the idea stopped being parked. While it was an unanswered musing it was exempt; the moment it was answered it became a defect.

**MECHANISM CONFIRMED IN SOURCE** (heal.rs:1896-1939). The loop over ANTICIPATES edges has exactly ONE exemption:
    if self.is_parked_idea(&index, &e.from_id) || self.is_parked_idea(&index, &e.to_id) { continue; }
and otherwise reports unconditionally. **NOTHING IN THE RULE LOOKS FOR FOLLOW-THROUGH.** It asks "is either side still a musing?" and its message asserts "nothing follows through" — two different questions. There is no check for a resolved status, an EVOLVES_INTO, a ChangeEvent, or any other trace of the anticipation having been acted on.

⭐ SO THIS IS INSTANCE ④ OF `dec:idea-the-load-bearing-prose-is-unchecked-against-the-code-it-describes`, found by the ordinary work of settling a decision rather than by looking for it — and it is the strongest instance, because the sentence and the computation ask different questions rather than the sentence merely over-reaching.

AND IT IS `req:a-deliberate-state-is-not-a-defect` AGAIN, in its sharpest form yet: the previous instances punished registering a document or leaving a requirement unsatisfied. This one punishes ANSWERING A QUESTION. The instrument is best when the design is most undecided.

⚠️ NOT ESTABLISHED, and it is why no repair is asserted here: what SHOULD count as follow-through is a real design question nobody has been asked. `EVOLVES_INTO` to anything? An `accepted` status on the target? A ChangeEvent naming it? Each answer exempts a different set, and the rule is `info` severity on one edge, so the cheapest honest option — do nothing and record why — is live. Severity `info` also means it never gated anything.

⚠️ BOUND: one edge, one measurement, on this graph. How many of this design's ANTICIPATES edges are in the same state was not counted.
